technology_name: ROBOTIC SYSTEM FOR HARVESTING CROPS IN VERTICAL FARMS AND METHOD THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Vertical Farming Automation / Crop Harvesting Robotics
problem_solved: Standard automated vertical farming facilities struggle to harvest dense, multi-tiered arrays cleanly without damaging fragile crops or requiring heavy manual labor.
description: A modular automated vertical farming system integration comprising a multi-tier structural crop framework, a high-precision robotic tracking manipulator arm, an optical crop scanner, and a centralized movement controller.
applications: Commercial indoor vertical farm facilities, urban hydroponic growing hubs, automated automated greenhouse sorting loops, and space-constrained agricultural cells.
